task_name: Add attachment schema and Kysely contract

concerns_addressed: The implementer's concern about the root test command was addressed by the controller's corrected server-workspace commands; the corrected unit test, real PostgreSQL integration test, and server typecheck all pass at the reviewed SHA.

strengths: schema.sql adds an additive idempotent cards-only attachments table with PNG/JPEG, positive 10 MiB size, timestamp, cascade, and deterministic cover-order index constraints.
The generated Kysely contract preserves the repository header and Generated<Timestamp>/Generated<number> conventions and registers attachments on Database.
The integration test applies the real schema twice against PostgreSQL and verifies rejection, ordering, and physical card-delete cascade; unit tests and typecheck pass.
The diff does not modify tracker tables, cards.version, public upload paths, or add a separate migration.

issues.description: The integration test's run comment still shows the unscoped root command, which invokes the broader workspace test script rather than the corrected server-workspace command used by the task packet.
